{{Top|leg}}
The '''b'rrsk''' was the object that teams fought for in the sport of [[phrenbi]]. Usually a ball, puck, or rock, the aim was for the team to get the b'rrsk into the opponent's goal. The rules stated that the b'rrsk could only be touched by the [[urran]], or playing stick. In [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Olys Corellisi]], "b'rrsk" translated into "head," while "phrenbi" translated into "decapitate."<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
